technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with SMA golden cross and ADX confirmation, but price remains below intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: F shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 9 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (98+ days old) with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (350.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings binary event in 9 days compounding volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with ADX and Supertrend confirmation provides short-term momentum entry signal, supported by contrarian fear-zone opportunity and price near support at 8.8647.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 9 days combined with VIX crisis levels, macro headwinds (flat yield curve, rising dollar), price below all intermediate moving averages (EMA-50, SMA-50, 200-EMA), and zero fundamental support create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
